name: 5-MeO-BET
summary: 5-MeO-DBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N,N-dibutyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator, and a rare substituted tryptamine derivative, which is thought to be a psychoactive substance.

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-DBT, also known as 5-methoxy-N,N-dibutyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator, and a rare substituted tryptamine derivative, which is thought to be a psychoactive substance. Unlike many other related compounds it exhibits very low efficacy for the 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT1A receptor agonist

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel designer drug by 2019 and was assessed pharmacologically in 2023.

fact.en: It carries two four-carbon butyl chains on its nitrogen, among the longest in the tryptamine family. Unlike most of its relatives, it acts mainly on the 5-HT1A receptor rather than 5-HT2A.
fact.zh: 它的氮原子上接著兩條四碳的丁基鏈，是色胺家族中最長的之一。與多數近親不同，它主要作用於5-HT1A受體，而不是5-HT2A。
fact.zhHans: 它的氮原子上接着两条四碳的丁基链，是色胺家族中最长的之一。与多数近亲不同，它主要作用于5-HT1A受体，而不是5-HT2A。
